desc:
# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/habitat-lab
- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/habitat-lab

## File: facebookresearch_habitat-lab/scripts/export_smplx_bodies.py

Prompts

```
['export a SMPL-X body model from Blender to a GLB file with baked shape keys', 'export a humanoid armature from Blender to a URDF file with joints and links', 'set a texture on the SMPL-X humanoid mesh using a file path or built-in texture name', 'setup mass and inertia properties on Blender bone types for URDF export', 'generate SMPL-X humanoid avatar files including GLB, FBX, and URDF from a body config JSON']
```

Usage

```
{'export_smplx_gltf': 'export a SMPL-X body model from Blender to a GLB file with baked shape keys', 'export_smplx_urdf': 'export a humanoid armature from Blender to a URDF file with joints and links', 'set_smplx_texture': 'set a texture on the SMPL-X humanoid mesh using a file path or built-in texture name', 'setup_smplx_bones': 'setup mass and inertia properties on Blender bone types for URDF export', 'generate_smplx_humanoid': 'generate SMPL-X humanoid avatar files including GLB, FBX, and URDF from a body config JSON'}
```
